children.name:
AssertionError: Payment due date mismatch. Expected: 2025-10-05, Got: None
assert None == '2025-10-05'
Given user's cohort programDate is updated, When there are 7 days left in the program, Then the paywall banner should be validated successfully

AssertionError: Payment due date mismatch. Expected: 2025-09-27, Got: None
assert None == '2025-09-27'
Given a user's program has plans assigned, When the programEnd_date is breached (days_until_payment_due=-1), Then the user should be blocked from accessing features

AssertionError: Expected 403 Forbidden, got 201
assert 201 == 403
 +  where 201 = <Response [201]>.status_code

Given a user has a valid subscription plan, When the user initiates a subscription, Then the subscription should start successfully and navigated back to the app to see subscription successful popup page

AssertionError: Subscription entry is failed to create 
assert None is not None
Given a user has subscribed to the plan, When the user tries to access the application, Then the user should not be blocked and should have full access
